### Hotel Equities Strengthens Presence in Caribbean and Latin America; Appoints Industry Veteran Marilia Pergola as VP of Operations for the Region 

 April 24, 2025 

ATLANTA, GA – April 24, 2025 – Hotel Equities (HE), today announced the appointment of Marilia Pergola as Vice President of Operations for the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA) region. Pergola will be based in the company’s Miami corporate office. 

“We are thrilled to welcome Marilia to the Hotel Equities family,” said Al Smith, President of Operations, Hotel Equities. “Her knowledge of the CALA landscape, coupled with her operational rigor and passion for people development, make her the ideal leader to inspire our associates and provide exceptional service to our guests and partners across the beautiful and dynamic CALA region.”

As Vice President of Operations – CALA, Pergola will lead operational strategy and execution across HE’s expanding portfolio in the region. With deep expertise in revenue management, brand compliance, financial performance, and pre-opening excellence, Pergola is poised to drive operational success, build strong owner relationships, and elevate guest experiences throughout the CALA region. Pergola’s appointment signals a major step in HE’s commitment to building an in-market leadership team that delivers elevated support and tailored solutions for owners and partners. 

“Marilia’s arrival underscores our dedication to the region and our long-term strategy to support growth with experienced, boots-on-the-ground leadership,” said Michael Register, who oversees new development for the CALA region at HE. “As we continue to expand our portfolio and partnerships, her operational acumen and cultural fluency will be invaluable.”

Pergola has over 20 years of experience in hotel operations with deep market expertise, including the past 8 years at Marriott International, where she most recently served as Senior Director of Operations – Owner & Franchise Relations for the Caribbean & Latin America. She managed a portfolio of over 100 full-service and select-service hotels, led franchisee engagement efforts, and spearheaded critical integration projects, including the loyalty merger of Starwood Preferred Guest with Marriott Rewards and the operational transition of City Express. ## Hotel Equities Promotes Dan Block to SVP of Operations

ATLANTA – June 26, 2023 – Hotel owner, operator and developer Hotel Equities (“HE”) is delighted to announce the promotion of Dan Block to Senior Vice President of Operations. In this expanded role, Block will oversee a diverse, multi-branded portfolio of hotels across the United States, driving operational excellence and ensuring outstanding guest experiences. Block will report directly to HE’s President of Hotel Operations, Al Smith.

Joining HE in March 2022 through the Greenwood 
Hospitality partnership, Block held the position of Vice 
President of Operations, overseeing a diverse collection of 
lifestyle and full-service hotels. “As we continue to grow 
our presence in the industry, it is imperative that we are 
equipped with talented leaders to drive our success,” said 
Aik Hong Tan, principal with Greenwood Hospitality. “Dan 
came to us with a skillset that supports all our operational 
goals, but most importantly supports our people-first culture,” echoed Tom Conran, principal 
with Greenwood. “His experience and dedication to Greenwood and Hotel Equities are key 
factors in maximizing operational efficiencies and guaranteeing maximum returns for our 
stakeholders.” 

Block brings a unique and robust perspective to servant leadership and hotel operations, with expertise spanning pre-opening initiatives, performance turnarounds, associate development, and owner relations. Block's notable accomplishments also include his culinary education at The Culinary Institute of America in New York, which has made an immediate and far-reaching impact on the enterprise. With over 39 years of experience in the hospitality industry, he excels in asset management relations and maintains exceptional interactions with hotel owners.

"Dan Block's promotion to Senior Vice President of Operations is a testament to his remarkable contributions and expertise in the field," said President of Hotel Operations, Al Smith. "His extensive background in hotel operations, commitment to servant leadership, and expertise is culinary arts uniquely positions him to elevate our operational strategies and enhance the overall guest experience."

As Senior Vice President of Operations, Block will leverage his wealth of experience and strategic vision to drive operational excellence, implement innovative initiatives, and foster a culture of exceptional guest service across the Hotel Equities portfolio.

Hotel Equities Announces Key Executive Appointments Across Operations, Finance, and Marketing Teams

### Hotel Equities Announces Key Executive Appointments Across Operations, Finance, and Marketing Teams

August 21, 2025

Hotel Equities(HE), a best-in-class hospitality operator and developer, today announces a series of key executive appointments across its operations, finance, and marketing teams. These leadership placements add proven expertise in areas critical to its next phase, from elevating portfolio performance and strengthening international financial operations to enhancing marketing impact for owners and brand partners. Together, these hires position HE for sustained success across the United States, Canada, the Caribbean, and Latin America.

“These appointments reflect our focus on aligning top-tier leadership talent with our strategic priorities,” said Ben Rafter, Chief Executive Officer of Hotel Equities. “Each of these leaders brings a proven track record in their respective disciplines. Together, they will play a critical role in shaping our unified platform, enhancing the experience for every associate and guest.”

The following executives have recently stepped into new leadership roles at Hotel Equities:

Taylor Hall – Vice President of Operations

Hall oversees operations for a portfolio of properties in the Midwest U.S.. She most recently served as Vice President of Operations at Aperture Hotels, where she managed a multi-branded portfolio of Marriott, Hilton, and IHG properties. In that role, she consistently drove RevPAR growth, improved GOP margins, optimized labor efficiency, and elevated guest and associate satisfaction across her portfolio. With a strong background in rooms and food & beverage operations and strategic revenue management, Hall has successfully guided properties through brand transitions and operational improvements.

Mike Hrusovsky – Vice President of Operations

Hrusovsky now leads operational strategy and performance for a multi-brand portfolio. With more than 37 years in hospitality leadership, he has directed operations for high-profile resorts and hotels in markets including Marco Island, San Antonio, and throughout Michigan. Hrusovsky is recognized for successfully navigating brand conversions and complex renovations while consistently delivering improvements in guest satisfaction. # Hotel Equities Appoints Jenn Thompson as New VP of Operations

 Jan 13, 2022 2 minute read 

 

ATLANTA – January 13, 2022 – Today, hotel owner, operator, and development firm Hotel Equities (“HE”), announced the addition of Jenn Thompson, CHA, NSA, CHIA as Vice President of Operations. In her new role, Jenn reports directly to Peter Tziahanas, Sr. VP of Operations and provides support and oversight of key assets to include HE’s owned properties within the firm’s growing U.S. portfolio of hotels.

> “Jenn joins HE with extensive hospitality experience and operations expertise,” says Tziahanas. “Her enthusiasm and aptitude have kept her at the forefront of the ever-changing hospitality industry throughout the entirety of her career. She is a tremendous asset and will help elevate the efforts of our operations team.”

Jenn is a decorated industry professional, beginning her career at age 19 as the youngest GM in the Western Americas for Marriott International, then advancing to open hotels in six states and work with every major hotel brand in both focused and full-service capacities. As a few highlights, Jenn opened the first Hyatt in the state of Oregon, then took the reins as General Manager of the prestigious Bidwell Hotel by Marriott in City Center Portland Oregon before holding roles as Area General Manager for Atrium Hotels, and opening the Historic Conversion Hotel of the Year, Washington, D.C. Magazine, 2018, under Preferred Hotels & Resorts. Most recently she held a corporate position within Interstate Hotels & Resorts, supporting transitions and major renovation projects in their portfolio. Jenn has earned a total of 9 career awards to date, including Hotel of the Year, Hyatt International, and GM of the Year for Interstate Hotels & Resorts.

> “I am excited to add value and further enhance the efforts of HE’s growing portfolio,” said Jenn. “I look forward to building great relationships and providing additional support to our leaders in the field.”

Jenn holds A.A. and B.S. undergraduate degrees in Business Administration, Higher Education Executive Leadership from Ducere Global Business School, and will graduate from the University of London in June of 2022 with an MBA in International Business. Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

### Hotel Equities Strengthens Leadership Team with Key Executive Appointments Across New Divisions 

 November 10, 2025 

Atlanta, GA – Hotel Equities (HE), a leading hospitality operator and developer, announces a series of strategic executive appointments across its Full Service, Focused Service, and Lifestyle divisions. These moves and additions will drive innovation, enhance performance, and help create lasting guest experiences across the portfolio—priorities for HE in generating long-term value for key owners and stakeholders.

“These executives bring exceptional talent and diverse industry experience to their newly created roles,” said Albert Smith, Chief Operating Officer of Hotel Equities. “Their leadership is integral as we continue to strengthen our lifestyle, full-, and select-service divisions across the U.S., Canada, and CALA, enhancing value for our owners and partners. By promoting from within, we’re investing in high performers who will help us grow our portfolio and expand our platform for innovation — from traditional hotels to new concepts like our leading outdoor hospitality brand, Postcard Cabins.”

Newly announced positions include:

Peter Tziahanas, President, Full Service Division

Peter Tziahanas joined Hotel Equities in 2021 and previously served as Executive Vice President of Operations, overseeing key lifestyle and owned assets across the firm’s portfolio. In his new role, he collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence, profitability, and enhanced guest and employee engagement. Before joining HE, Peter held several multi-unit leadership positions with prominent management groups, including Pivot Hotels at Davidson Hospitality Group, where he successfully led the lifestyle operating vertical.

David Rosenberg, President, Focused Service Division

David Rosenberg joined Hotel Equities in 2020 and most recently served as Executive Vice President of Operations, where he oversaw the deployment of analytics-driven performance dashboards, managed M&A integrations, and led a substantial portion of HE’s multi-branded hotel portfolio. He also guided the company’s entry into the outdoor hospitality segment through the integration of Postcard Cabins into the portfolio.
